references.text: The previous verse describes the pomegranates and bells on the hem of the robe, which verse 34 continues to detail with the alternating pattern.
Parallel text describing the actual making of the gold bells and pomegranates on the hem of the robe, as they were made by Bezalel.
The description of the ephod's robe where the bells and pomegranates were to be attached.
The next verse explains the purpose of the bells—that their sound would be heard when Aaron entered and exited the sanctuary.
The pomegranates on the pillars in the temple reflect the decorative motif of pomegranates from the priestly robe.
The original command regarding the decoration of the robe (28:34) is confirmed as fulfilled in its execution (39:25).
The specific pattern from the command (28:34) is confirmed as carried out in obedience to the Lord's order.
Describes the material and colors of the pomegranates included in the pattern from 28:34.
Pomegranates, as a holy symbol, are transferred from the high priest's robe to the temple pillars.
